mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate indicates an accommodative monetary policy, which may stimulate economic growth and lead to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in 60% of the 20-day windows following a low FEDFUNDS, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate suggests economic weakness, potentially leading to negative S&P 500 returns in the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in 60% of the 20-day windows following an unemployment rate increase, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts indicates strong demand, which may lead to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in 60% of the 60-day windows following a housing starts increase, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in both unemployment rate and payroll employment suggests a complex labor market, potentially leading to positive S&P 500 returns in the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in 60% of the 20-day windows following the joint increase, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production indicates strong supply, which may lead to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in 60% of the 60-day windows following an industrial production increase, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: High federal funds rate coupled with slowing GDP growth may indicate monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in 60% of the 60-day windows following the trigger, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Strong GDP growth indicates robust demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in 60% of the 60-day windows following strong GDP growth, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: Rising inflation (CPI) coupled with low unemployment may lead to tighter monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 returns in the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in 60% of the 20-day windows following the trigger, the hypothesis is rejected.
